about_the_game:
The war may be won, but work continues for Solgante's pilot! Joint training exercises are being held with Tomzon Base, and only Captain Will can show them how it's done by demonstrating the techniques that brought Radulta victory. Through a sequence of training battles, help the other base's soldiers learn how to fight like champions! Alternatively, you can train using your neighbor Naji's home-built simulator, and prove yourself worthy of his admiration.

-Meet new characters!

-New sprites for the beautiful Eleanor and the main character!

-Naji made a new simulator just for you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 8/8.1/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 11/10/8
  • Processor: 2+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
